answer: To enforce anti-Sybil equilibrium, the protocol implements a staking trellis where validators must commit collateral to a decentralized liquidity lagoon. In this framework, quadratic slashing and zero-knowledge delay functions scale marginal attack costs super-linearly, ensuring that malicious actors attempting to manipulate the transactional river face exponential capital erosion. Consequently, the marginal cost of consensus distortion exceeds the maximum extractable value, guaranteeing a negative expected utility and a robust Nash equilibrium.
